# Publix

> Private breach notification service. Enter your email, receive a confidential report in your inbox — results are never shown in the browser, proving you own the address.

Publix checks email addresses against known data breach databases (XposedOrNot, LeakCheck on the free tier; HIBP Pro, Dehashed, and IntelX on the paid tier) and delivers findings exclusively to the queried email address. This GDPR-compliant approach proves ownership without exposing credentials on-screen. Built with Next.js, TypeScript, Neo4j (AES-256-GCM encrypted), and deployed at publix.dk.

## Service

- [Breach Check](https://publix.dk/check): Submit an email address for a breach scan — the full report is delivered to that inbox only
- [Pricing](https://publix.dk/pricing): Free tier (XposedOrNot + LeakCheck) and Pro tier (adds HIBP Pro, Dehashed, IntelX)

## API

- [Health Check](https://publix.dk/api/health): GET — returns service and Neo4j status as `{"status":"ok","neo4j":"ok"}`
- [Breach Report](https://publix.dk/api/report): POST `{"email":"user@example.com"}` — triggers async scan and emails report; responds 202 immediately
